Hi guys, 3 months ago I made a post asking for workout advice which you guys helpfully supplied. Now I wish to share an update. After that post i joined Planet Fitness and worked out using their resistance machines for about 3 weeks before I sustained a (unrelated) knee injury and was told to stop by my doctor until it healed. The injury wasn't serious, but due to tendon inflamation I required weeks of physical therapy before I could walk straight and, recently, jog without pain. The thing is, when I started PT they not only said that I could workout, but encouraged it. Eventually I realized that I was using my injury as an excuse, I was so dejected by my own weakness and ill health that I had given up. My brother was the one who really inspired me to get back into it. He had set up his own workout station and had been following the StrongLifts 5x5 program for over a year. He had tried to get me into it several times and finally after realizing the source of my unhappiness I decided that I needed to do it. It has been 3 weeks, as of today, and since then I have only missed one day when I had a bad cold. For the first time in my life I feel like I'm actually improving my health. When I started, I was deadlifting only 95lbs, today I lifted 125lbs, more than I weigh (although I've gone up 5lbs from all the eating). I know it isn't impressive for many of you, but for me it means more than I can express. I spent years of my childhood in and out of the hospital/ER and have always struggled to remain healthy. Now, I am looking forward to each workout. I feel healthier, happier and am filled with confidence and hope. I feel like a new man ready to take on the world! I fully intend to keep this new habit going for years to come. Thank you guys for helping me out and for keeping me inspired all these months. Shout out to the guys over at /v/SelfHelpForABetterMe too, for helping me maintain a positive attitude about life in general.
